- .github/workflows/validate.yml:517-529 | severity=low | confidence=5

  WHY: Repositories that depend on the previous behavior now hit a hard failure instead of the fallback path.

- scripts/validate_process.sh:2159-2166 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The template-mode guard error message is not actionable enough to guide operators to the correct fix.
  WHY: When this guard trips, users get a failure without enough remediation guidance.

- scripts/validate_process.sh:2159-2166 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The freehand generation path was removed, so setting `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` now hard-fails with no fallback.
  WHY: Any repository still relying on freehand generation loses the previous behavior and must migrate fully to templates.

- scripts/validate_process.sh:2262-2268 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 covers both missing/too-old Python and renderer script failure.
  WHY: A single exit code forces operators to inspect logs to distinguish environment problems from renderer bugs.
